reviews.author: xia0yuer
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 10 Music 9.0 Rewatch Value 7.5 This review may contain spoilers The Four Musketeers of Emergency Medicine Wang Yang Ming and Liu Fei are two newly graduated doctors who compete for one full time position at the prestigious An Kang Hospital. Liu Fei is taken under the wing of even-tempered and careful Dr. Zu while Wang Yang Ming is shoved at the curmudgeonly Dr. Lu, who is minutes away from quitting for a much better paying private hospital job. Under the tutelage of these mentors, Wang Yang Ming and Liu Fei grow their skills, learn to overcome hospital politics, and become top emergency room doctors.My favorite character is Dr. Lu Yi (Louis). He's both an old grouch, extremely dedicated doctor, and the comedian of the group. His character growth really stems from empathy. He starts off as a brash, highly skilled but hard to get along with doctor with a massive chip on his shoulder for not getting promoted, to an understanding, confident man who is willing to sacrifice his career but not his morals for those he cares about. Wang Yang Ming and him make a dynamic duo, but Lu Yi always felt realistic while Wang Yang Ming felt a little too idealistic. All four main characters and the supporting characters were all solid, thought Dr. Guan (Big Boss Guan) is worth a particular shout-out. She was an teacher and manager to the four, giving life lessons and pushing at the right times to make these four better.This drama could have cut down 10 episodes, as it started dragging around Ep 26. They inflated the story by adding three side romances and varying degrees of drama. My biggest criticism is that Meng Jiaoyang, Dr Bao, and Wang Huan didn't become their own strong characters - they just helped push the storyline forward and became enablers to the men in their lives. I would cut most of the romance because the medical drama and brotherhood between the four main characters really didn't need it to sustain interest in the story. The medical cases themselves also became less interesting in the second half of the drama.Overall, one of the best medical dramas I've seen since With You (2020). Highly recommend for a pleasant mix of lighthearted comedy, drama, and brotherhood. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: dramafordays
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 This review may contain spoilers I was so excited to watch this drama but half way through I felt like I was trying to convince myself to still really like it. Drama had so much potential… it just never seemed to go beyond “just okay”. Instead of focusing on the main leads, the storyline was everywhere… touching on each person and their relationships but never going deep enough. I liked ML but his trauma was resolved so late, he didn’t seem to have much character growth. Although romance wasn’t suppose to be a big part of this drama, I felt like there should have been more since drama brought it up and spent initial episodes trying to develop something. It was a bummer because nothing felt completely satisfying and there was one too many motivational speeches and monologues which made me want to hit the fast forward button. Despite all that, this really wasn’t a bad drama….the strong brotherhood, tug of war as a sport, and actors and actresses were likeable (at least most of them), I never quite figured out who was the FL…maybe there wasn’t really one. The portrayal of coaches was a little much but I’ve seen my share of crazy coaches too. I give writers props for writing the coaches in that way… although it’s wrong, I have a feeling that’s what a lot athletes face on the daily. Overall, It was a cute watch but my expectations were probably just too high. I can’t bring myself to rate it less than an 8!! Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Wynndzofchange
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 Facing Difficulies With Courage I usually don’t watch many college-age sports themed dramas, but I was looking for something fluffy and not filled with angst and chose this one. Much to my surprise, I actually enjoyed it.As I said, I don’t normally watch this genre and the reason is my feet get twitchy, my hands get sweaty and it feels like I am participating from the bleachers 😂I’ve read comments about how long it took the ML to ‘get over’ the loss of his friend, and zi find that rather irritating because these people have probably never experienced having someone they care about die in front of them. It is a horrible experience - I know this is fact because I have lived it. It’s not something you can just ‘get over’ or overcome quickly. Especially when you don’t allow yourself to grieve like the ML did. It’s traumatic emotionally and physically. His stoic “long face” was there to block anyone from getting close to him so he didn’t have to feel that type of loss and pain again.The beautiful thing about this drama is that the showed everyone has their problems and dreams and even though things were hard, they eventually dropped their”I’m fine” masks and were able to bond as friends and teammates.Therewere annoying characters, obnoxiously narsicistic jerks, people with family dynamic issues, fearful of failure and many more. They all eventually managed to overcome their issues and develop into healthy people.There was a hint of romance which is typical of college scenarios, but the main focus was the tug-of-war team.By working through their own problems and trying to establish a sport club on their campus they learned what things are important and to let go of things that hindered them.Of course there were odd things included, and logic holes in the storyline. But despite those things, this is a nice watch if you’re into building strong relationships even in difficulties. No running or hiding, but eventually working toward mutual interests and goals. reviews.author: MyLangyaList
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 7.5 Rewatch Value 8.0 Play spy games, win spy prizes ‒Overview‒Spy Game is a riveting spy thriller that has many terrific aspects that makes it worth watching. The acting is excellent and features a star-studded lineup, with slick action sequences and a fantastic performance by Wang Likun. The plot is tightly-paced and features many well-executed twists and turns. The cinematography and production is considered and high quality. And the icing on the cake is the razor sharp dialogue that's subtle, intelligent, and evasive, delivering the immersive tension of witnessing the high stakes spy vs. spy maneuvers. That said, there are a few elements that may be off-putting to some viewers. The setup of the drama is based on a spy organization that recruits real-life agents through a virtual game. If you accept the setup and not fuss too much about the CGI in the virtual world, you will find a surprisingly engaging drama. On an additional note, I was initially weary of how much propaganda element there might be in the drama, but it actually turned out to be minimal and the bad guys were all depicted as intelligent and with reasonable motivations.‒Review‒This was actually my first full-length drama that I really enjoyed this year. At the time, I had suffered through 6 months worth of uninteresting releases and abandoned disappointments. I picked this up mostly as a masochistic for-science exercise to see how quickly brain-dead propaganda would force me to drop the show. This was produced with assistance from China's MSS (Ministry of State Security) after all, an agency similar to the CIA/FBI. To my surprise, after a few initial lukewarm episodes, I was captivated by the intelligent script and dialogue delivered by a terrific cast lineup. My only regret is that I wanted to write an in-depth review and hence delayed it and now I can only put down a fraction of my impression about the show.The show starts out simple, and even a little cheesy with the virtual game world. It quickly becomes apparent that the virtual 'Spy Game' is actually a recruitment tool for a real spy ring working for some shadowy foreign organization. Two of our main leads, Huang Zicheng, played by Wei Daxun, and Yao Yao, played by Li Yitong are quickly caught up in their first mission and get entangled in a plot to steal cutting edge R&D. And luckily or unluckily for Huang Zicheng, his adoptive brother is an agent at the Ministry of State Security, China's counter-intelligence agency. Thereafter, the multi-layered plot unfolds to include a growing roster of players from the MSS, from the shadowy spy organization Night Fog, and innocent or not-so-innocent citizens. Soon you find yourself immersed in a thriller trying to figure who is friend or foe, who is involved in the conspiracy, and how the characters will protect their loved ones and catch the wily bad guys.I was pretty satisfied with the plot throughout, including the ending. Writing an engaging plot for a spy drama is more demanding than for the average show. While Spy Game wouldn't belong to the top tier of spy dramas, it nonetheless achieves what I consider to be solid 'reel logic'. For the events that are shown on screen, the logic is solid and consistent with the world and characters. If you want to get super picky and start extrapolating to what's not shown, then it would require such tight world-building that few TV shows ever achieve. And the story was told with enough sophistication that a few twists were unexpected and the foreshadowed twists were engaging and well-executed. I was especially pleased that the show ended on a high note. It's so easy to entice the viewer along with smart intrigue that never get wrapped up. The ending here was logical, impactful, and climatic.The acting from the large ensemble cast was excellent. For comparison, Li Yitong is generally a very solid actress and one of the better ones in idol dramas. And Wei Daxun went from an unknown to a rising star after thoroughly outclassing Yang Yang as the SML in Fireworks of My Heart. While they were solid in this show, they were probably the weaker actors in comparison. Everyone just embodied their role so well and Wang Likun absolutely slayed. The only acting sore spot was Zhang Haowei in his minor role. Whether in JoL, Ripe Town, or here, Zhang Haowei has never delivered a character that felt completely sincere. This doesn't bode well for him as he's trying to exonerate himself from some pretty shady scandals, as he's incapable of convincingly portraying sincerity even when he's not playing a shady character.For some final thoughts, the dialogue was terrific. I especially enjoyed the cat and mouse verbal sparring between Han Geng and Wang Likun's characters, so normal, yet so layered. I'm also glad the villains were three dimensional and sympathetic, which made the show much more intriguing. I hope other shows take note, especially spy and Republican dramas. When you flatten and dumb down the bad guys, you are also in effect insulting the intelligence of protagonists and viewers.This was a solid 8.1 ‒> 8.5 MDL and a top 10% Cdrama of 2023.--Category Ratings--- Overall - 8.1- Plot - 8- Theme / Concept / Impact - 8- Acting - 8.5- Visuals - 8.5- Audio / Music - 7.5- Rewatch - 8- Cultural/Topical Accessibility - 7- Subtitle quality - 8 Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Joku
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.0 Story 3.0 Acting/Cast 5.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 The basic idea of this drama is interesting Apart from the basic idea, it's hard to find anything good about the drama. During the first two episodes I thought this was a bad parody of spy movies - I was wrong - this is just a very bad spy drama.The plot and events are full of contradictions and lack of logic, and both the authorities and the spies often act so illogically and stupidly that the drama should be called "Spy Games for Dummies".The bad script is probably partly to blame, but all the actors perform poorly, even Li YiTong who usually performs excellently in all her roles is uninspired in this drama. Wei Da Xu's "performance" as Huang Zi Cheng is a complete flop.The VR scenes are also completely unrealistic, for example everyone who uses VR will surely notice how ridiculous it is to "teeter" on roller skates when the movement is made with a controller and the person is actually sitting.One example of illogicality in this drama ( there are dozens ): An Spy organization draws up a multi-part plan to steal something. The route of the courier carrying the object is planned so that at a certain point he disappears from all surveillance cameras - and after that he can no longer be located. However, the handover is planned to take place a few hundred meters BEFORE this disappearance. In addition, the handover takes place directly to the car visible in the surveilance camera. reviews.author: lilly.eddie2019
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 3.5 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 1.5 Rewatch Value 1.0 Story makes no sense Where do I start. I think the story would be better if they were not 5 mins long. Also I think some of the dialogue is lost in translation. The male and female leads are good looking. The supporting cast act well, but overall the story makes no sense. For a story like this to work there needs to be more of a preamble towards their deepening love. It's like the male lead bumps into female lead. Female lead then meets him again after she gets drugged and placed in the male leads bed. From that encounter she becomes his girlfriend. WHAT!!! No logic. Both of them have been drugged and placed in that situation, so why isn't the police involved. Then they fall in love. HOW!!! Where is the courtship? Where is the lead up to the relationship? Also the ex boyfriend of the female lead is vile. He goes from being her childhood saviour, to an utter shit. He is (with his new girlfriend) responsible for the female lead being in dangerous situations with other men. Just really disappointed with his drama. Has great potential to be a really interesting, gripping, romantic drama. Instead it is a rushed, mishmash of other stories, thrown together to make a series. Disappointed. 😔 Read More Was this review helpful to you?

title: Disappearing Mom
also_known_as: Familiar Stranger , Gone Mom , Hot Mom's Battle , My Mommy Disappeared! , The True Mother , Xiao Shi De Ma Mi , 消失的媽咪
synopsis: Ning Xing Er steals Luo Wan Wan's baby in order to marry the rich, Han Wei Chi, by deceiving him into thinking she is the woman he slept with months prior. Luo Wan Wan, now suffering from amnesia, returns five years later with another child that she had been carrying, one that Ning Xing Er failed to notice. She wishes to search for her child's biological father. Will Han Wei Chi, who was deceived, be able to tell the real from the fake? These two fraternal twins now each have a mother of their own. Can Han Wei Chi follow his heart to find which woman will bring him happiness? (Source: MyDramaList) English Español Português (Brasil) 한국어

reviews.author: HayleyFourie
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 6.5 Rewatch Value 8.5 ?️ THE LITTLE HOT PEPPER WHO CAPTURED YOUNG MASTER PEI OVERALL IMPRESSION🌟This was a fresh and entertaining variation of the substitute-bride trope. The FL agrees to marry an unconscious wealthy heir in her stepsister’s place, believing that a comatose husband might be the simplest part of the ridiculous arrangement—until the ML unexpectedly wakes up! Instead of immediately becoming a sugary romance, their relationship develops through suspicion, constant bickering, petty revenge and undeniable attraction. Watching the ML transform from Mr “I want a divorce” into Mr “She is my legal wife!” was thoroughly satisfying.WHAT I LIKED💖• The FL was strong-willed, bossy and no pushover. Her nickname, “little hot pepper,” suited her perfectly because she recognised when people were exploiting her and refused to tolerate disrespect quietly.• I loved that the FL was not desperate to remain Mrs Pei. While the ML suspected her motives and wanted her gone, she was equally determined to regain her freedom and independence.• Their bickering and petty retaliation were far more entertaining than instant love. Even while they irritated one another, it was obvious that the FL had already crawled under the ML’s skin.• The ML’s transformation was delightful. He went from demanding a divorce to becoming increasingly possessive, protective and frightened that his wife might genuinely leave him.• I enjoyed the FL’s outrageous plan to make the ML’s father dislike her enough to approve the divorce. Her complete frankness was hilarious—although the ML certainly did not appear pleased by her enthusiasm!• The FL fought many of her own battles instead of sitting around waiting for the ML to rescue her. Even when placed in dangerous or humiliating situations, she remained calm enough to protect herself and retaliate.• Once the leads lowered their defences, they formed a beautiful relationship. They were playful, caring and increasingly willing to share their vulnerabilities.• The emotional conflict surrounding the substitute marriage worked because both characters had understandable reasons for feeling betrayed and hurt.WHAT I DISLIKED⚠️• The ML and his family repeatedly blamed the FL whenever something went wrong, sometimes treating her cruelly before learning that she was innocent. It was painful and infuriating to see how quickly they devalued a woman who had done nothing to deserve their mistrust.• The FL’s stepfather and so-called cousin were completely without conscience. Their scheme against her crossed an unforgivable boundary and made their eventual punishment extremely satisfying.• The ML’s reaction after discovering part of the truth was understandable emotionally, but he judged the FL too quickly and assumed their entire relationship had been built upon lies.• Several misunderstandings could have been avoided through honest communication, especially once the leads had already developed genuine feelings and trust.• Some of the family violence was excessive and made the FL’s repeated mistreatment difficult to watch.PRODUCTION AND PERFORMANCES🎭• Chen Tian Xiao and Kan Zi Yi delivered believable performances and excellent chemistry, especially considering this was the first of their six collaborations.• Kan Zi Yi maintained the FL’s strength throughout the drama. Even during vulnerable moments, she never made the character feel completely helpless or dependent upon the ML.• Chen Tian Xiao portrayed the ML’s progression from suspicion and irritation to jealousy, protectiveness and hopeless devotion very naturally.• Their breakup was particularly emotional. The ML appeared completely shattered because he believed the woman he loved had deceived him, while the FL was devastated that he could so easily doubt everything they had shared.• The pacing was fast and lively, while the leads’ chemistry successfully carried both the comedic bickering and the heavier emotional scenes.FINAL THOUGHTS💭This was an enjoyable substitute-bride romance with a strong FL, a possessive ML and an entertaining enemies-to-lovers dynamic. I loved watching Young Master Pei realise that the wife he initially wanted to remove had become the woman he could not bear to lose. Although the FL’s repeated mistreatment and the ML’s lack of trust frustrated me, their chemistry and emotional performances kept me invested. The open ending introduced the kind of final complication I had already suspected might appear, so it did not come as a complete surprise. Rather than diminishing my enjoyment, it left me curious about what would happen next and wishing the story had continued long enough to explore the consequences. Fast-paced, refreshing and brought beautifully to life by two well-matched leads, this was a drama I thoroughly enjoyed and can happily recommend. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

title: Rock and Peking Opera
also_known_as: Rock Peking Opera , Yao Gun Li Yuan , 搖滾梨園
synopsis: During the holiday of Xiang Yu's junior year in college, he returned to the opera troupe run by his grandfather, Xiang Yan Liang, with his own band. The arrival of a group of four people stirred up the originally peaceful life in the opera troupe. Xiang Yan Liang, a two-time plum blossom award winner and titan of the laosheng role, hoped that his grandson would inherit the mantle, but the accident ten years ago made Xiang Yu Xin unable to face his heart calmly. Yu Ji, a child prodigy of Peking Opera who is deaf in both ears, Lin Qin Yi, an iceberg beauty who fled from home, Zhou Shu Ting, who rebuilt the old drama "Double Snake Fight" in order to vindicate her name, Lin Si Si, a talented girl who can sing both male and female roles, all the characters appeared. Around the tradition and change of Peking Opera, a holiday encounter started. Here is the popularization of general knowledge of Peking Opera, the reappearance of classic plays, the reflection on the present situation and the praise of youth. Xiang Yu Xin's troubles are the troubles that all young people have faced or will ultimately face, and Xiang Yu Xin's choice is the affirmation of courage given by this drama. (Source: WeTV) English हिन्दी Español Português (Brasil)

reviews.author: Ggrosz
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 8.5 Rewatch Value 6.5 Blending Old & New The lack of promotion for this series, plus the lack of proper subtitles, made it difficult for viewers to discover & enjoy this series. A unique story of blending new & old arts, plus the hurdles of keeping and maintaining an old culture not only by the older generation but also the new generation. This series not only offered entertainment but also education on China's exquisite entertainment culture. I came out of it learning a lot. It also depicted brotherhood and sisterhood in different ways. It's a good watch if you can get through the rough subs. I had to use a translator 80% of the series for better understanding so it took me longer to watch it. There's no synopsis nor list of artists who participated here. Some of the main artists are Liu Yi Hun, Mu Hao, Yang Jun, Yang Wen, Liu Xiao Li, Li Xuaner and other veteran artists. Its a story of a young man with a family entertainers in Peking Opera. He excels as a performer in this field and could follow his grandfather's footsteps as an international awarded Peking Opera performer but his focus is on his rock band. Upon stumbling on the opera's situation after returning home with him bandmates, he was grapling on how to continue his path in the rock band, and help salvage his family's Peking Opera group.Whole production did good in setting, scenes, and props but could improve in wardrobes for the characters. Repeat and recycled wardrobes are always easy to catch. The opera costumes and headress were exquisite though. Love the little information shared about it. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.0 Story 6.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 4.0 This review may contain spoilers For a jiejie romance released in 2023, this was OK I found out about this drama from subreddit CShortDramas. Even though the actor who played ML in this drama does not have MDL profile, I have seen him in another drama "Haunted Dreams". I enjoyed this drama.What I liked:1. Romance - I liked how their relationship developed. They were strangers who were compatible & comfortable with each other. The shopping trip was sweet.2. FL characterisation - She was kind & endearing.3. ML characterisation - I liked that he was kind & likeable. He genuinely cared for his jiejie.4. Supporting characters - ML's assistant was the MVP. I also liked Qian Li.5. Acting - I liked their performances and I think their chemistry was good.What I disliked:1. Bullying - This drama was released in 2023 so I wasn't surprised that bullying scene was included in this drama. FL's department team members were nasty.2. Antagonists - Wei Wei & Mr Shen FL's ex were horrible. I also disliked ML's mother for being gullible & self-absorbed - caring too much about status.3. Age difference - Sometimes I wonder how does a writer determine the ages of ML & FL when writing an age gap romance. If I am not mistaken the age gap for this drama is 10 years. It would have been better if the age age was reduced to say 5 years since ML was a president of a big company. Favourite sceneDate at the night market Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Dank je wel
reviews.review_text: Overall 10 Story 10 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 10 This review may contain spoilers Amazing short dramas with banter and so light hearted 🔴🔴SPOILERS!!!!!🔴🔴YOU WON'T REGRET IT!!!!A MUST WATCH!!!!I seriously love this drama way more than I should😭. The trope was classic but I loved how the first 40 chapters only everything was sorted out, both of them formed a rapport and were so supportive of each other from the start.✨Toxic male lead behaviour? What is that? A mother in law who hates you? Does that type of thing exists?I love An Cheng so much considering the fact she was one of the love rivals, and my heart really took a dip when she invited Gu Nein to Mrs. Fu's birthday but other than that.... LOVED HER!!!!It was nice seeing a love rival who actually had sense and ethics and the female lead and her mother... No words. Just say too amazing.And their newly wed banter was a cherry on top? How he just always appeared in her house garden, whenever he upset her.He was such a green forest and at one point I actually got scared of him when he was dealing with Yu corporation but who cares...There was no excessive drama, everything was just too perfect but yeah, the writer shouldn't have killed his mom?😭That was so unfair towards her 'and' him. She couldn't see his one and only son's wedding?The scene where she was giving An Cheng that necklace, i swear to lord I lost it and burst into tears. Mrs. Fu didn't had much of a screentime but had such a huge impact on the storyline, it's almost terrifying.She was a perfect mother looking after her son, and taking care of him, trying to find someone who would help him overcome his childhood trauma.And don't get me started on the male actor, he was soooooooooo fine. Call me and idiot, but he was just too fine like a glass of Gordon & MacPhail 85 year old Glenlivet. 🙈🙈And the female lead was sooooo cute, I have no words. She was so pretty and she did the businesswoman role sooo good. She was elegant, strong and had so much fire and never hid her thoughts. She is just too wonderful to describe. ✨🥺And Mr. Lin?, first drama where it actually showed what the secretary of a world famous organisation's CEO has to go through. What things they have to do for their boss and etc. and I really feel like, no matter what, he should have been the ring bearer?The script write was done so well, there were almost no loopholes in regard of a vertical drama. Loved it so so much. The fashion designer was awesome, gave everyone clothes which reflected their personality (which let me tell you is a big thing when you are watching vertical dramas). Mo ling had different coloured clothes which reflected her rather free spirit, An Cheng had dark clothes which showed how closed off she always is and Mr. Fu had suits of different types which suited his personality. And the cast appointment was I guess my favourite because everyone fits their role so much (Maybe except Gu Nian's mother but it's not like she has a lot of screentime.) The villains were dealt with quickly and everything was so smooth, I didn't even realize when the drama finished and when I finally did realize it, it was already too late. I loved how they used Goblin's soundtrack so wonderfully and the songs were so fitting to the situation.I know this is not so famous but if there's any way, I need a sequel man😭, it's way too good... Would love to see all the characters again.A must watch for flash marriage trope lovers who are looking for a change and also for people looking for a lighte hearted watch with amazing character development and very healthy relationship between male and female lead✨You would love it and trust me, want to re-watch it again and again because the dialogues are so catchy. I folded, a spoiler:"Just watch your man turn this around and save the day"AHHHHHH!!!!!!Go check this drama out ... NOW!!![Note: The actor who has played male lead and the actress who has played An Cheng are in one more drama together. Jijun Zhang (the male lead) is the male lead there too and An Cheng is a important side character. The drama is 'Unbridled' Go check it out too] Read More Was this review helpful to you?

title: King of Basketball
also_known_as: Jin Ji Le, Wo De Gao Ge , 進擊了，我的高歌
synopsis: Xu Ge Wei, a struggling documentary director, is assigned to shoot a promotional film for a once-glorious private college basketball team that has now fallen to the bottom of the rankings. Confronted with a team shrouded in failure and players who have lost their fighting spirit, Xu Ge Wei rises to the challenge. With her tenacious character, she helps the team rebuild their faith and revitalize their training. She also uses her camera to document the growth of each player, including Gao Ge, as they navigate their confusion. Through their journey, she creates a powerful tribute to youth, friendship, and perseverance. (Source: TMDb) ~~ Inspired by the true story of the men's basketball team of Huaqiao University. title: True False Love
also_known_as: Zhen Qing Jia Ai , 真情假愛
synopsis: Housewife Wang Ping Guo suspected that her husband was cheating but never found evidence to prove it. Unexpectedly, her younger sister Wang Mei Mei was the one who had an improper relationship with Chen Chao behind her back. Chen Chao disliked Wang Ping Guo because she didn't bear him a child, so Wang Mei Mei took the opportunity to sabotage their marriage and use it as her trump card. She also deliberately framed Ping Guo for cheating with her neighbor You Yuan. On the grounds that she was pregnant with Chen Chao's child, Wang Mei Mei encouraged him to divorce and cooperate with her to seize the property left to Wang Ping Guo by Wang Ping Guo's mother. A few months later, Wang Mei Mei and Chen Chao got married. At this time, a woman named Qiu Xiao Yun appeared next to them, but nobody knew that it was Ping Guo, now hungry for revenge. title: Shen Tan Jiao Shou
synopsis: Liu Guang Ming, a professor at the Public Security University, and his student Zeng Cong, a criminal policeman, who have different jobs, different personalities, and great differences in words and deeds, but their sense of responsibility and mission make them tacit partners on the public security front. Liu Guang Ming is keen, erudite, humorous, with careful logical thinking and reasoning ability, and the work of solving cases has become a contest of mind and perseverance; Criminal policeman Zeng Cong in other hand is funny, reckless, but full of integrity, tenacity and perseverance. These two, starts their crime solving journey, because of the murder of a writer, Guang Ming, as a time witness of the suspect was invited into the police reception room by Zeng Cong, where he used careful scientific reasoning, rigorous psychological analysis, and gradually grasped the truth of the case and brought the criminal to justice. (Source: Chinese = Douban || Translation = MyDramaList) English हिन्दी Español Português (Brasil)

synopsis: Shen Yi Zhou, the president of the branding color makeup company, has two major troubles - one is that due to his high requirements and standards, the new air cushion that the company is developing has not met his requirements, and the other is that he suffers from severe insomnia, which has seriously affected his work and life. Just when Shen Yi Zhou was almost defeated by his problems, a girl named Xia Xiao Tang, applied for a makeup R&D engineer. Shen Yi Zhou is soon surprised, discovering that as long as Xia Xiao Tang touches him in an emotional situation, he can sleep peacefully. Social phobia internet celebrity Chen Mo is a junior majoring in photography, and she is devoted to her live broadcast career. The eldest sister Da Gao Jie is a junior majoring in filmmaking, mature and steady, she hopes to become an excellent producer. The rational star-chasing girl Xia Xia is a freshman in the screenwriting major, and she wants to become a professional screenwriter with high IQ and EQ. Silly and sweet Qiao Lu Lu is a freshman in the directing major, and she hopes to become a director with a pleasing personality. The four of them share their adolescent thoughts together, strive for their ideals, and grow into a better version of themselves. reviews.author: F4luv89
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.0 Story 4.0 Acting/Cast 4.0 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers What on earth did I just watch? I was looking to watch this because I saw the male lead played One from Go Go Squid and was interested to see how he would be as a male lead. Unfortunately my expectations were too high. I expected a campus story, and from the summary above, an interesting love triangle (which isn’t always a turn off if done right). Instead, I was presented with garbage.It starts off with the story of 3 “siblings” who are all adopted by Grandpa Lu (Lu Jin Bai takes after grandpa’s surname because he did not even have a name or knew where he came from before he met grandpa - the other two seemed to know where they came from). However, when they were young (elementary school aged), grandpa dies and almost leaves them to grow up on their own (but they have a “guardian”, Dr. Liu, who is also Xiao Ting’s cardiologist). So Lu Jin Bai is oldest brother, Wu Su Kai is second brother and Bai Xiao Ting is youngest sister.Pretty much immediately, it is clear that BXT has the hots for LJB but he does not necessarily reciprocate. Instead, his sole focus is to earn money to cure BXT, as that was his promise to grandpa before he passed. So as a result, he works many odd jobs to support their family. BXT encounters many fainting spells and the doctor says her only hope is a heart transplant. Somehow the premise of the doctor being an organ donor comes up and LJB decides to also become one (foreshadowing what is to come).At the halfway mark, due to a motorcycle accident, LJB passes away and his heart (shocker) is a match for BJT. Poor WSK has to lie and tell her that LJB has gone abroad to make more money to pay off the debts for curing BXT (I don’t think she realizes the extent of how bad her situation is/was). And this is where it just goes off the rails. Basically, his interests “float” into her body: she likes motorcycles, flirting with girls, and can now fight. Just a ridiculous story. Please pass on this, not worth the time (even though it’s quite short). However, there is a catchy song in here that was apparently sung by a Korean singer (in Chinese), hence I gave some higher marks for OST. If you are going to include transplant as a storyline, don’t use a main character! I would recommend “Time and Him Are Just Right” instead - that one is done right. synopsis: Gu Jin Tin, the only daughter of General Zhen Guo, entered the palace to marry the emperor, ostensibly the empress Jiang Men who enjoyed all the glory and wealth, but in fact she was a hostage left by Emperor Xie Jun's side. The emperor slaughtered all the Gu family on the grounds of rebellion. Shao Yu Ming, the deputy general under General Zhen Guo and Gu Jin Yin's bamboo horse, launched a palace mutiny and committed suicide after stabbing the emperor. After Gu Jin Yin's death, she traveled to modern times and became a star in the entertainment industry and found that it was the emperor Xie Jun who had a marriage contract with her, and Xie Jun's brother was General Shao. Reborn once, Gu Jin Yin, who has memories of her previous life, made up her mind not to repeat the mistakes of her previous life. Meanwhile, Lu Wei Da's real purpose is to make the game's monster "Chimeras" to appear in the real world, and eventually rule it by controlling them. In order to capture Lu Wei Da, the Hyperspace Guardians from the future world sent Lu Cai Feng, a member of the psychic patrol team to chase him down. Lu Cai Feng found that Long Xiao Feng, a college student, was a suitable "warrior" candidate. Long Xiao Feng's sister, Long Ling Ling, also came under Lu Wei Da's control. After hard training, Long Xiao Feng grew up to be an excellent armored soldier. At the same time, "Chimeras" began to attack the real world. In order to rescue his sister and protect the world, Long Xiao Feng and his friends started to fight against the monsters in the game "Wonderland" and challenging the game developer. synopsis: Zhen Jian Ren's wife tragically miscarried, dashing the Zhen family's hopes for a grandson. However, the Zhen family took their anger out on their granddaughter, An An. So, the attending doctor, Qin Zi Xin, took An An away. It just so happened that Fu Yan Ci was passing by, and Qin Zi Xin recognized that the photo in Fu Yan Ci's hand was of An An's mother, Ying Ying. Fu Yan Ci's heart tightened, and he immediately grabbed Qin Zi Xin to go look for An An. He never imagined that his sister Ying Ying and his niece An An had suffered such great injustice all these years. When An An woke up and saw Fu Yan Ci and Qin Zi Xin, she called them 'Mama' and 'Papa.' However, the Zhen family didn't let An An go. reviews.author: Shin
reviews.review_text: Overall 3.0 Story 3.5 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 1.5 Rewatch Value 1.0 Week plot weak characters weak chemistry I’m convinced the police department doesn’t exist in Chinese short dramas. The FL rescues a child from an abusive father and instead of dialing one number or even threatening legal action, she goes full spiritual influencer mode whispering, “Karma will come for you.” Well, karma missed its train, because the parasite came back and kidnapped the kid again.As if karma’s disappearance wasn’t tragic enough,this woman gets slapped around 5 to 7 times in a two-hour-fifteen-minute plot. She’s not even a female lead at this point, she’s a designated punching bag with dialogue privileges.And the ML or whatever that is , wasn't better either I mean his unhinged fiancée slapping his wife and psychologically distressing his baby niece he just letting this mental woman slide with soft warnings every time ..the warnings which she treats like friendly suggestions and ignores right away.. Sure, let’s blame it on his “business obligations”. Billion-dollar deals, global meetings, blah blah. Meanwhile, a walking mental hazard is out here terrorizing his wife and traumatizing a child, and his grand solution is… a warning speech that too delivered in installations . Not security, not legal action, not medical help ....not even an advisory " stay away from this woman".With such weak characters chemistry seems even bigger luxury ... And as you must have already predicted it was flat .. blank faces .. artificial tears ... sunkissed look and loads of forced forehead kisses ... Even their love making scene felt like a skincare commercial. So if you have a low bar for everything you can definitely watch it but remember it wasn't recommended by me ... synopsis: Hao Zhi Zhi got married for the second time to Shen Xiao Yang, a young talent who was ten years younger than him. Hao Zhi Zhi learned the lessons from his previous marriage failure due to being too strong, and began to learn various love skills at an early age. "Coquettish women are the best". But the "strong woman" nature engraved in her bones is often exposed. Although Shen Xiao Yang is young, he has shouldered the responsibility of a husband. He understands the truth that a good man should not fight with a woman, is infinitely tolerant and willing to give in to others. Suddenly one day, Wu Da Fu, the uncle of Shen Xiao 6ang's hometown, fell from the sky and began to stay at Hao Zhi Li's home. Wu Da Fu was the youngest and the oldest in the family. Hao Zhi Zhi never thought that one day he would have to serve a seventeen-year-old uncle in his forty years of life. Hao Zhi Shi's niece Er Qiao is about the same age as Wu Da Fu and has a weird and tricky personality. She doesn't care about her seniority. In Er Qiao's eyes, Wu Da Fu is just a fat guy who messes up his life. The two are not convinced by each other and fighting and bickering happened. Later, with the debut of Hao Zhizhi's mother-in-law and the addition of Hao Gang, Hao Zhi Zhi's "daughter slave father", the strange family of six began a happy and funny life. title: Schrodinger's Youth
also_known_as: Goodbye Youth , Zai Jian Qing Chun , 再見青春
synopsis: Wang Guo Dong, who was in the spring of his career, received an invitation to the funeral of his first love Liu Bing on a sunny afternoon. During the years when he was separated from Liu Bing, he had fantasized about reuniting with her countless times, but never in such a decisive way. Her death turned all the resentment and unwillingness Wang Guo Dong had towards this woman over the years after their breakup into his first love. With a lot of question marks and longing for Liu Bing, Wang Guo Dong returned to the place where they grew up together. At Liu Bing's funeral, he reunited with not only Erjin and Gang Zi, his childhood friends who had lost contact due to misunderstandings over the years, but also the living Liu Bing, the protagonist of the funeral. The appearance of Liu Bing made Wang Guo Dong feel that he had been ruthlessly tricked by her again. He also adjusted his memories to more than ten years ago and had to remember the most sincere, but most wanted to forget the past. However, Wang Guo Dong, who got the truth, seemed to have lost everything again the moment he recovered his past... (Source: LeTV) English हिन्दी Español Português (Brasil)

reviews.author: Ariana
reviews.review_text: Overall 10 Story 10 Acting/Cast 9.5 Music 9.5 Rewatch Value 9.0 Appreciate the struggles you have gone through to reach where you are now. Even though the characters of the story went through many struggles, it gave a sense of courage when the characters never forgot their past and appreciated how far they have gone to get to the level they are on. The main lead in the story gave a message to many people that with a goal there's many circumstances, and to have the confidence to continue experiencing what you have been through shows your determination in many aspects. From the example in the drama, the main lead would cry because he lost someone he cared about. If you feel guilty of something in the past and you try your best to make up for it, no one will blame you. Everyone has a problem to solve on their own. You can't avoid your own differences and don't try escape. If you don't overcome it will follow you forever. This is a lifelong message to the universe, and I would really encourage many people to watch this drama. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

synopsis: The story centers on trillion-yuan CEO Fu Ting Xiu, who conceals his identity and enters a flash marriage with Meng Ning. After marriage, he accompanies his wife in running a street stall while secretly supporting her jewelry design career. When Meng Ning faces workplace discrimination due to her educational background, Fu Ting Xiu intervenes indirectly through his secretary to protect her. Meanwhile, his mother continues to pressure him to reveal his true identity. reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Classic drama. This drama is the third drama i ever done when i first watching short drama in 2024.The plot is about FL and ML met on unexpected encounter, decide to have a whirlwind marriage. However, ML maintains a mysterious identity and past. FL begins to suspect ML true identity. She discovers that ML was once a gang leader but changed his identity after a certain incident. Through a series of interactions, FL decides to face MLs past together and help him solve his problems. They experience a series of dangers and trials without any money.The thing that i liked for this drama is Sun Yue remark. He may not the most handsome but his acting was quite smart and he can hinder his other leads weakness especially Xu Yizhen. Such a rare gem on short drama not many actors cannot do that. Even the romance and kisses were not sensual but you can feel the dynamic duo between them. Xu Yizhen embraced resilient FL who wants to know ML hidden secret.If you want to watch classic decent drama, watch this. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

complete_title: Da Shu Hao Hao Chong Wo (2023)
also_known_as: Uncle Pampers Me Well , 大叔好好寵我
synopsis: Treated poorly by her family upon returning from the countryside, Yun Chu Chu faced an ultimatum: pay an exorbitant dowry or be forced into a devastating marriage, crushing her university dreams. Refusing to comply, she ran away and unexpectedly met Mo Lian Cheng, the powerful president of the Mo Group, who secretly suffered from a mysterious illness. Discovering that Chu Chu's blood could treat his condition, Lian Cheng desperately needed a bride. To escape her family's crushing demands and secure her freedom, Yun Chu Chu agreed to his deal: marriage in exchange for financial security. This arrangement allowed Yun Chu Chu to bypass her family's pressures and gave Mo Lian Cheng the solution to his dangerous affliction, thus beginning their unconventional marriage full of hidden reasons and unexpected turns. (Source: Chinese = Baidu || Translation/Edit = MyDramaList) ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Da Shu Hao Hao Chong Wo" (大叔好好宠我) by Xiao Piao Liang (小漂亮). English Español Português (Brasil) 한국어

title: Tao Sheng Mo Tian Lou
also_known_as: Escape Skyscraper , 逃生摩天樓
synopsis: Song Qing is a hydropower maintenance worker. When he was working in the revolving restaurant on the top floor of the Polaris Tower that day, he encountered an earthquake. The South Jixing Tower under construction next to the Polaris Tower collapsed, causing a fire on the top floor and blocking the only escape exit. The fire spread, and the only way out for the tour group was the elevator shaft. However, the elevator encountered a fire and a power outage and stayed on the top floor. When everyone panicked, Song Qing, who was passing by, heard the call for help. He stepped forward and tried to get the elevator out of the fire pit. reviews.review_text: Overall 6.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 2.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 Chong Sheng Zhi Jiang Men Di Fei (2023) is a rebirth drama with a very slight romance that has Hou Mingxuan (as Chu Qingce) and Xia Qian as (Xie Zhiyun) in the leading couple’s role. The story is more about Xie Zhiyun rebirth after she and her family are betrayed by her husband and her adopted sister. In her new life, she gets revenge and gets in a relationship with Prince Chu Qingce. Although the plot was nice, the acting is not that great and the romance is toned down; also the acting is not the best. This miniseries can be sees on YouTube under the caption: God has given me a new life, and in this life, I will surely scatter you to ashes. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: BanxiTheCommentaryGrrl
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 9.0 Rewatch Value 9.0 A Visually Rich, Art-Forward Watch I watched this without subtitles and still greatly enjoyed it, which speaks to how visually expressive and thoughtfully crafted it is. The storytelling relies less on heavy dialogue and more on mood, atmosphere, and visual composition. Emotion is conveyed through framing, pacing, and the deliberate use of color, allowing the audience to feel the narrative even without understanding every word.That said, it may not be for everyone. This is best suited for the eclectic viewer—someone who appreciates aesthetics as much as plot, who enjoys artistic or unconventional narratives, and who notices the intentional use of specific color palettes to signal tone, character dynamics, or emotional shifts. It’s the kind of experience where patience is rewarded, and the beauty lies as much in how the story is told as in the story itself. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

title: Yu Sheng Wei Ni
synopsis: Ming Zhao has been considered an unlucky person since he was born, so he was sent to live in the countryside by his parents at a very young age. Until one day, his father, whom he had not contacted for many years, suddenly sent someone to take him home. Ming Zhao originally thought that blood was thicker than water, but his father changed his mind and talked about their family relationship with him. Unexpectedly, his father brought him back just to use him. It turns out that the mysterious wealthy Shi family proposed a marriage with the Ming family. But Lord Jiu, who is married to the Shi family, not only has his legs disabled but is also moody and suffers from severe bipolar disorder. Ming Zhao's parents were reluctant to marry Ming Zhao's sister Ming Yiqing, who had been with them since childhood, to this "crazy cripple", and they couldn't afford to offend the Shi family, so they thought of taking Ming Zhao back and marrying Ming Yiqing instead. In the process of fighting against fate, Ming Zhao discovered that his marriage partner, Shi Yuan Mu, was not the perverted and ugly person rumored to be. On the contrary, he was a kind and lonely person. Ming Zhao and Shi Yuan Mu also developed feelings during their stumbling relationship, true love. title: Drunken Chrysanthemum
also_known_as: Drunk Chrysanthemum , Ju Hua Zui
synopsis: In the Qing Dynasty, in a certain place in Hunan, there were two local tea houses owned by two brothers who had become enemies due to a misunderstanding. Despite their shared passion for tea, they refused to speak to each other or work together. However, things started to change when the emperor expressed his desire for tea from Hunan to be used as tribute. Realizing the significance of this opportunity, the brothers and their sisters put aside their differences and joined forces to produce the best tea possible. Through hard work and dedication, the tea produced by the reunited families became highly regarded and eventually earned the honour of being designated as tribute tea for the emperor. In the end, the two brothers and their sisters reconciled and continued to honour the tea-making tradition together. (Source: CK Warrior at MyDramaList) English magyar / magyar nyelv dansk Norsk

title: Travel Through Time
also_known_as: Wo Zai Gu Dai Dang Wang Hong , 我在古代當網紅
synopsis: Zhou Rong Qian is a popular internet celebrity. One day as she is biting an apple, she is transported into ancient times. When she wakes up, she realizes that she is now the slave of the owner of a tea house, who has sold her to an old Lord and also an owner of another tea house, for marriage. Suddenly some fighting swordsmen appear and Zhou Rong Qian ends up hurt because she thinks it’s a dream and wants to play with them. When she wakes up, the Lord who bought her has come to fetch his new bride, but luckily he has a heart attack and dies in front of her. So, Zhou Rong Qian thinks quickly and claims that since she and the old Lord were already married, she is now the new owner of his tea house. Her claim is approved but before she is able to open the Tea House, Han Qi, a poor but handsome man who wants to become a scholar, comes to the door and she offers him to stay and together they open up the tea house. Afterwards, she uses her wits and modern day knowledge to conduct different kinds of business, earning her some powerful enemies, but also powerful allies. Things get complicated when Zhou Rong Qian gets entangled with the powerful Emperor. (Source: PeeWee69 at MyDramaList) English हिन्दी Español Português (Brasil)
